answer: Median drift alarm: if an epoch's median seal drifts over 0.5 points from the mean of the last 6 epochs, the panel grows from 7 to 11 graders for 2 epochs. Fable is the baseline ledger of those 6 medians. Mirror is the replay check: 5 percent of rows go to new graders and are compared with the first panel. Lotus is the cooldown that shrinks the panel after 2 clean epochs. Failure mode: a clique nudges medians by 0.1 per epoch to stay under the alarm. Check rule: audits flag cumulative drift above 0.3 over 4 epochs. Cheapest bypass: shift only unreplayed rows unless sampling stays hidden.
